commands.name: Make disposable launchers meet runtime provenance permissions
commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
ci_python_path="$(python -c 'import os, sys; print(os.path.realpath(sys.executable))')"
# setup-python's tool cache may be group-writable; production binding
# intentionally rejects that. Tighten this ephemeral runner, not policy.
sudo chmod go-w "$ci_python_path"
stat --format='%a %U %n' "$ci_python_path"
ci_java_path="$(readlink -f "$(command -v java)")"
sudo chmod go-w "$ci_java_path"
stat --format='%a %U %n' "$ci_java_path"

commands.name: Existing OpenHAB Python tests (disjoint file partition)
commands.command:
set -euo pipefail
mapfile -t test_files < <(python - <<'PYFILES'
from hashlib import sha256
from pathlib import Path
import os
shard = int(os.environ['TEST_SHARD'])
for path in sorted(Path('openhab/scripts').rglob('*.py')):
    if path.name.startswith('test_') or path.name.endswith('_test.py'):
        if int(sha256(path.as_posix().encode()).hexdigest(), 16) % 3 == shard:
            print(path.as_posix())
PYFILES
)
test "${#test_files[@]}" -gt 0
# Keep the normal disjoint hash assignment. This one cross-repo
# integration contract uses its own immutable consumer/SQL profile
# in a fresh process; never mix companion modules between profiles.
general_files=()
bms_aux_file=''
for test_file in "${test_files[@]}"; do
  if [[ "$test_file" == 'openhab/scripts/test_bms_aux_producer_consumer_postgres.py' ]]; then
    bms_aux_file="$test_file"
  else
    general_files+=("$test_file")
  fi
done
general_status=0
if [[ "${#general_files[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then
  python -m pytest -q "${general_files[@]}" || general_status=$?
fi
bms_aux_status=0
if [[ -n "$bms_aux_file" ]]; then
  PYTHONPATH="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/openhab/scripts:$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.ci/solar-pv-bms-aux/analytics/src:$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.ci/solar-pv-bms-aux/analytics/tests" \
    python -m pytest -q "$bms_aux_file" || bms_aux_status=$?
fi
printf 'general_pytest_exit=%s bms_aux_pytest_exit=%s\n' "$general_status" "$bms_aux_status"
[[ "$general_status" -eq 0 && "$bms_aux_status" -eq 0 ]]

commands.name: Require one executed full qualification fit
commands.command:
python -m pytest -q -ra openhab/scripts/test_thermal_fit_evidence.py::test_real_qualification_fit_is_exercised_only_on_the_hosted_runner --junitxml="$RUNNER_TEMP/qualification-fit.xml"
python - <<'PYTHON'
import os
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
root = ET.parse(Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'qualification-fit.xml')
cases = root.findall('.//testcase')
assert len(cases) == 1, 'exactly one qualification fit must execute'
assert cases[0].get('name') == 'test_real_qualification_fit_is_exercised_only_on_the_hosted_runner'
assert not root.findall('.//skipped'), 'qualification fit must not skip'
assert not root.findall('.//failure') and not root.findall('.//error')
print('qualification_fit_executed=1 skipped=0 failures=0')
PYTHON
